_comment: Frozen test set. Same person + garment fed to every model. `python scripts/verify_assets.py` writes a contact sheet.
_round: Round 3 (2026-09-02 pm): male person swapped to a full head-to-toe casual base (Indian man, black polo + cream chinos + sneakers, plain bg) so menswear jeans/trousers/t-shirt render with proper contrast and full leg. Womenswear + female model unchanged from round 2. t-shirt.jpg rebuilt as a clean black tee from a plain flat-lay (original was black-on-black, unsegmentable). coat now coat-over-polo (lost the shirt+tie of the round-2 suited base).

persons.female: MANUAL: user-supplied. Indian woman, full head-to-toe, plain white bg, wearing a beige kurta set (kurti + palazzo + dupatta). Good base for Indian wear.
persons.male: MANUAL: user-supplied. Indian man, full head-to-toe, plain grey bg, black polo + cream chinos + white sneakers, hands in pockets. Round-3 replacement for the suited man (kept as _male_suited_prev.jpg).

garments.t-shirt: MANUAL: user-supplied plain black crew-neck tee. Original was black-on-black (near invisible) -> round 3: rebuilt as a clean solid-black crew tee from a plain flat-lay so it segments cleanly.

garments.jeans: MANUAL: user-supplied. Men's grey jeans, on white.
garments.trousers: MANUAL: user-supplied. Men's charcoal dress trousers, on white.
